1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __not__ embedded in the test tube.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __at a location other than__ the bottom.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded __above the bottom of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube that __does not__ comprise an RFID tag.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the __sidewall__ of the test tube. 

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in an area __not limited to__ the center bottom of the container.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded at an angle __above the bottom__ of the container, oriented for reading.
